common_mistakes.mistake: Pac leaves STEADY before Isp clears the unstable bridge; separately, a ferry/island-side miss may land near the recovery fold.
common_mistakes.consequence: A ferry or island-side approach miss can be a safe traversal loss near the fold. The fold is not beneath the bridge: collapse while Isp is on x=650-930 can drop Isp into lethal slime and cause death/restart.
common_mistakes.recovery: Use the x=450-500 island-side fold only for a safe approach miss, then repeat ferry/bridge traversal. It does not recover a bridge fall into slime; that failure may require restarting the route.
